gaps.sentence: The film is based ___ a true story.
The children were excited ___ the trip.
You ___ have seen a doctor sooner.
gaps.explanation: 'should have + participle' criticises a past decision.

gaps.sentence: By this time next year, she ___ finished her degree.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect: will have + participle by a future point.

gaps.sentence: We should make the ___ of the good weather.
gaps.explanation: 'make the most of' = get the maximum benefit from.

gaps.sentence: ___ being nervous, she delivered a flawless speech.
The project ran ___ of money halfway through.
gaps.explanation: 'Run out of' = use up the supply.

gaps.sentence: The new law comes ___ force next month.
gaps.explanation: 'come into force' = officially start to apply.
